QUOTE: This is a source-level gate, not encapsulation. The struct layout stays in the public header, so `sizeof` and offsets are still visible. What the macro buys is that accidental or unsupported field access fails to compile

WHY: The answer says opacity is enforced at compile time by renaming the member to `private_<name>`, while the layout and sizes stay visible.
